description: Show the active project — the folder every faf_* call without a path uses — and the .faf there; pass path to make another folder the active project (your home folder and the filesystem root are refused). detail: true also returns the .faf's text. Writes no file. Call it once at the start of a session.

detail.description: Also return the text of the .faf (read with faf-cli's reader), for reading project.faf in one call

path.description: Set active project path. If omitted, shows current context.

name: faf_context

outputSchema.description: The active project context and whether a project.faf lives there.

active.description: Absolute path of the active project

changed.description: True if this call set a new context, false if it only reported

content.description: detail: true — the text of the .faf

hasFaf.description: Whether a project.faf (or .faf) was found there or one level up

path.description: The .faf file readers use (faf-cli's finder: the folder, then one level up), if found

title: Active Project
